Models
The best for the job
Access OpenAI GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Opus 4.5, Gemini 3 Pro, and more. Pick the best model for the task.

Run different tasks with different models in parallel, or switch between models for a given task, all without leaving your workflow.
Integrations
Agents where you work
Connect Warp to Slack, Linear, and GitHub to get AI help right inside your tools. Mention @Warp to investigate bugs, suggest fixes, or open PRs—no context-switching.


With real-time session links and shared visibility, anyone can see, guide, or review what the agent is doing.
Your privacy and security
Transparency and control at every touchpoint.

Your data, secure and private

Warp is SOC 2 compliant and has Zero Data Retention policies with all contracted LLM providers — no customer data is retained, stored, or used for training.

App telemetry can be individually configured and automatically enforced for teams.

Complete control of your agents

Control exactly how much autonomy agents have, from approving every step to allowing full autonomy. Configurable at the individual and enterprise level.

Learn how credits work and how to get the more out of an AI credit.

Full transparency

You can read the list of high-level telemetry events that sent for app analytics and monitor telemetry in real-time with our native Network Log.

Explore Privacy at Warp

Features
Tools for writing code
Agents

Warp’s Agents handle complex coding workflows with context, task management, and customizable autonomy, keeping you in control while they do the heavy lifting.

Agent Management UX

Run multiple agents in parallel, track their progress on complex tasks, and step in easily when they need help.

Agent Profiles, Permissions, and Autonomy

Customize how your Agent behaves—from its models and autonomy to the tools and permissions for reading, writing, and executing commands & code.

Model Choice

Choose from a curated set of top LLMs for Warp's Agents, or let Warp auto-select the best model.

Agent Task Lists

Track and manage complex Agent workflows with automatic task lists that break requests into clear, actionable steps and update progress in real time.

Agent Notifications

Agents alert you when they need your input—whether it’s permission to run a command or approval to apply a code diff.


Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Extend Warp’s Agents with custom tools and data sources using MCP Servers — modular plugins with a standardized interface.

Coding

Powered by the leading coding agent, Warp helps you build, debug, and deploy complex features across production codebases with built-in code review UX, a native code editor, and more.

Agent Context

Attach multimodal context to your prompts alongside the Agent’s built-in knowledge from CLI tools, MCP servers, and team resources.

Modern Code Editor

Unlike other CLI-based coding tools, Warp includes a fully native code editor. It’s streamlined for quick improvements to the code your agent writes.

Codebase Context

Write code across large, multi-repo codebases with real-time indexing for accurate, context-aware responses. No code is stored on Warp servers.

Suggested Code Diffs

Active AI

Automatically surface potential fixes for command-line errors encountered.

Collaboration and Warp Drive

Warp centralizes knowledge from Workflows, Notebooks, Prompts, Rules, MCPs, and more, enabling agents and teammates to build and ship high-quality software.


Personal Drive

Keep your personal development knowledge in a cloud-based library next to your command line, or share it publicly. 


Team Drive

Create a shared Warp Drive to collaborate on workflows, notebooks, prompts, and more with your team.

Workflows

Save parameterized commands for reuse.

Notebooks

Create interactive runbooks that live in your terminal.

Prompts

Save and reuse parameterized Agent Mode prompts to run on-demand.


Environment Variables

Save or sync environment variables to load into your terminal sessions.

Rules

Create reusable global or project-based guidelines to ensure Warp’s agents follow your coding standards, project conventions, and personal preferences.

Session Sharing

Share sessions and command line controls.

Warp Drive on the Web

Access your Drive objects and Shared sessions on a browser.

Warp Drive as Agent Context

Warp’s agents automatically use your Warp Drive content to provide more personalized, context-aware responses.

Modern Terminal

A world-class terminal with a code-editing experience for commands and endless customization, as powerful and intuitive as your favorite text editor.

Fully cross-platform terminal

Available on macOS, Linux, and Windows. Works out of the box with Zsh, Bash, fish, PowerShell, WSL, and Git Bash.

Universal Input

All-in-one input for commands and prompts: run natural language or CLI commands, add context with @, and navigate with vim-style keybindings.

Blocks

Input and output grouped together for easy navigation, sharing, and filtering.

Prompt Suggestions

Active AI

Get contextual, Al-powered suggestions that activate Warp's Agents.

Next Command

Active AI

Preview and accept AI-generated command suggestions tailored to your terminal session and history.

Custom themes

Select from a theme library, code your own, or use the GUl to create a theme with a color palette from a background image.

Command Completions

Press TAB to cycle through intelligent completions, with built-in specs for hundreds of popular commands and libraries.

Command Palette

Quickly search across the Warp for commands, keyboard shortcuts, Warp Drive objects, navigation, settings, and toggles.

Launch Configurations

Save any combination of windows, panes, and commands to re-open as a preconfigured session in the future.

Extensions and integrations

Support for all the popular CLI tools and frameworks – PS1, Starship, Spaceship, Powerlevel10k, Oh My Posh, Oh My Zsh, and countless others.

Privacy & Security

Warp is SOC 2 compliant and enforces Zero Data Retention policies with all contracted LLM providers, ensuring that no customer AI data is retained, stored, or used for training.

Zero Data Retention

Enterprise

Zero Data Retention ensures your data is never stored or used for training, with policies you can configure individually and that are automatically enforced for teams.

SAML-based SSO

Enterprise

Integrate with your company's approved authentication provider.

Secret Redaction

Automatically obscure sensitive values like API keys as you work or share terminal content, reducing the risk of exposure.


Disable Active AI

Option to disable proactive Al recommendations based on command inputs, outputs, and errors for fixes and next actions.

Disable telemetry

Option to disable analytics and crash reporting for the higher-level feature metrics Warp monitors for product quality.

<script>
  function getParameterByName(name, url) {
    if (!url) url = window.location.href;
    name = name.replace(/[\[\]]/g, '\\$&');
    var regex = new RegExp('[?&]' + name + '(=([^&#]*)|&|#|$)');
    var results = regex.exec(url);
    if (!results) return null;
    if (!results[2]) return '';
    return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, ' '));
  }

  function setCookie(name, value, days) {
    var expires = "";
    if (days) {
      var date = new Date();
      date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
      expires = "; expires=" + date.toUTCString();
    }
    // Optional: set a broader domain so cookies work across subdomains.
    var host = window.location.hostname;
    var domain = host.split('.').length > 2 ? "." + host.split('.').slice(-2).join('.') : host;

    document.cookie = name + "=" + (value || "") +
      expires +
      "; path=/" +
      "; domain=" + domain +
      (window.location.protocol === "https:" ? "; secure" : "") +
      "; samesite=lax";
  }

  function getCookie(name) {
    var nameEQ = name + "=";
    var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
    for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
      var c = ca[i].trim();
      if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) === 0) return c.substring(nameEQ.length);
    }
    return null;
  }

  function captureUTMs() {
    var utmParams = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content'];
    var utmChanged = false;

    utmParams.forEach(function (param) {
      var value = getParameterByName(param);
      if (value) {
        var existingValue = getCookie(param);
        /* Only set the cookie if the new value differs */
        if (existingValue !== value) {
          setCookie(param, value, 7); /* Set cookie to expire in 7 days */
          utmChanged = true;
        }
      }
    });

    /* If any UTM parameter was updated, refresh others to extend expiration */
    if (utmChanged) {
      utmParams.forEach(function (param) {
        var existingValue = getCookie(param);
        if (existingValue) {
          setCookie(param, existingValue, 7); /* Refresh expiration */
        }
      });
    }
  }

  function populateFormFields() {
    var utmParams = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_term', 'utm_content'];
